## Badge Descriptions

| Badge | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| CI | Main CI workflow status (lint, test, build) |
| Tests | Test execution status across Node versions |
| Coverage | Test coverage percentage from Codecov |
| CodeQL | Static code analysis for security vulnerabilities |
| Security Scan | Snyk security vulnerability scan |
| Dependency Review | Automated dependency vulnerability check |
| Release | Automated semantic release status |
| npm | Weekly downloads from npm |
| Bundle Size | Minified + gzipped package size |
| Dependencies | Number of dependent repositories |
